Subject: General

Topic 5.4: Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you enjoy reading stories? 2. How do you make your composition interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Patriotism is developed as learners create narrative compositions featuring traditional foods for different communities

showing respect for each other.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Socio-Environmental issues – Assertiveness is enhanced as the learner masters the art of creative writing and can freely

express themselves via writing.

Link to other Subjects:

The learner applies the knowledge about traditional food crops to other subjects such as Agriculture and Nutrition and Science

and Technology which have similar concepts.
